metadata.description: Post-Unified Reasoning Milestone blind benchmark. Evaluates Simplicial Type Theory integration and unified shared-service consistency across battery, polymer, metal, ceramic, and cross-domain families. Targets recent 2024-2026 literature findings and complex interface cases.
metadata.selection_policy: Forty source-backed pairs selected from 2024-2026 research papers, SCHOTT/MO-SCI technical datasheets, and established materials handbooks. Balance maintained between positive (standard/novel compatible) and negative (mismatch/corrosion/oxidation) controls.
metadata.holdout_policy: Frozen on 2026-05-27. No tuning allowed against this file until Q8 results are reported. Treat as blind validation.

episodes.resolution_notes: no_verdict:scorer_unavailable_or_error: Standard soda-lime glass is highly susceptible to alkali-metal corrosion and cannot be used in direct contact with lithium.
no_verdict:scorer_unavailable_or_error: Cabal-12 (calcium-boron-aluminate) is engineered specifically for lithium metal contact in hermetic battery seals.
false_negative:polymer: PVC and PEO are a known miscible polymer blend family due to hydrogen bonding.
false_negative:ceramic: Spinel and magnesia are chemically compatible at high temperatures and share similar CTE.
false_negative:polymer: Both are fluoropolymers with similar chemical resistance and moderate interfacial adhesion.
false_negative:ceramic: Compatible for high-hardness composite armor and structural applications.
